ladder.purpose: Confirm final-message files exist without publishing raw text.
ladder.advance_condition: All lanes show FINAL_MESSAGE_READY and no strict marker blocker remains.

ladder.purpose: Separate structural correctness from enough depth for x2 use.
ladder.advance_condition: Minimum headings, item counts, and word threshold pass.

ladder.purpose: Resolve generic marker warnings as true blockers or false positives.
ladder.advance_condition: Sensitive/path/raw markers are zero after strict review.

ladder.purpose: Relaunch only the lanes that failed quality, with stronger prompt constraints.
ladder.advance_condition: Repair launch receipt has heading contract, temp-only output, and a next-check gate.
Productive-wait verifier passes for the repair launch.

ladder.purpose: Confirm repaired artifacts are deep enough for x2 build synthesis.
ladder.advance_condition: Both CLI lanes pass final-message, marker, and elaboration quality gates.

current_repair.reason: Initial artifacts were structurally valid but below elaboration threshold.
